commits.notes: Historical upstream path record. Batch 35 ports the two barrier attack paths to the local pending/active protection lifecycle. Moon Barrier checks the attack source’s effective Dragon type and allows Shred damage to bypass the protection. Mind Bend and Severe Poison resolve through attack effects, with the stronger Poison bundled into its status application. The other card and engine paths from this commit remain under review. Batch 36 extends the local provenance route to 265 verified status attacks. These card paths report conditions through the resolved attack, including on copied attacks, and continue to use power-origin effects for actual Abilities. Batch 37 extends that route to 397 classic status attacks. Source review corrected printed attacks on the two Noble Victories Cryogonal prints, Secret Wonders Bulbasaur and Undaunted Leafeon. Batch 38 corrects 144 more Special Condition attacks, including multi-condition attacks, coin thresholds, copied attack provenance and independent effects on the attacker. It also removes erroneous Confusion from Data Retrieval and confines that bonus to Scramble Trip. The tracked queue drops from 306 to 137 remaining sites. This partial port preserves the fork’s attack pipeline. Batch 39 verifies six switch-then-status attacks, Poison Rub’s pre-damage switch, and delayed Knock Outs. Typed protection now checks the selected Bench slot and the actual source of delayed effects. This resolves 14 more call sites. The remaining queue has 123 sites across 112 card definitions. Batch 40 verifies 72 more attacks and resolves 81 sites. Optional Energy costs now use the Energy each card actually provides and require successful discard, including Prism Star routing. Ice Bind and Leaf Hurricane resolve after damage. The tracked queue contains 42 calls in 41 definitions.
